UsageRecord.title: Usage Record
UsageRecord.description: Records every image or video generation, including tokens, cost, and the username of the account that made the generation.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of when the generation was made

tokensUsed.description: Total tokens consumed by the generation

details.description: Specific details of what was generated

username.description: Username of the account signed in during generation

lollys_api_usage_history/{recordId}.description: Historical log of all generated content across all accounts.
